official_definition: While your "Bannerace"/"God-King" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't block unless they send a core from their Life to the Void.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Banner God Strike] or [Banner God Strike: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Banner God Strike]", "give [Banner God Strike]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
